commits.author: JExcellence | Justin
commits.message:
fix(entity): map UuidEntity id via SqlTypes.UUID so it works on PostgreSQL

@Column(columnDefinition="BINARY(16)") forced a raw DDL literal into CREATE
TABLE; PostgreSQL has no BINARY type, so table creation failed there entirely.
Use @JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.UUID) for the dialect-native type: uuid on
PostgreSQL/H2, binary(16) on MySQL/MariaDB, uniqueidentifier on SQL Server.

MySQL/MariaDB storage unchanged (binary(16)); H2 type name changes
BINARY(16) -> UUID (migration note in CHANGELOG for existing H2 data).

Guarded by IntegrationTest.uuidIdMapsToNativeDialectType.

commits.author: JExcellence | Justin
commits.message:
fix(entity): make @Version column nullable so hbm2ddl=update can add it to populated tables

BaseEntity.version was a primitive int -> NOT NULL column. Adopting BaseEntity/LongIdEntity/
UuidEntity/StringIdEntity on an existing populated table made hbm2ddl=update emit
"add column version integer not null", which fails the H2/MySQL table rebuild on existing rows
(logged as a WARNING and swallowed, leaving the column missing and later writes broken).

- version is now Integer (nullable column), defaulted to 0 so a freshly constructed detached
  entity still carries version 0 and merges cleanly (createOrUpdate path).
- public int getVersion() unchanged and null-safe (legacy rows read as 0); toString via getter.
- @Version on Integer is permitted by the JPA spec; no @Column(nullable=false)/columnDefinition.
- Audited: LongIdEntity/UuidEntity/StringIdEntity don't shadow version. JEHibernateRevisionEntity
  keeps int id / long timestamp (dedicated Envers table created whole, PK/timestamp correctly
  non-null) — flagged, not changed.
- VersionMigrationTest: update adds nullable column to a populated table, existing rows read 0,
  fresh schema starts at 0, optimistic locking still throws, stricter NOT NULL column still works.

Bump to 4.0.1.

commits.author: JExcellence | Justin
commits.message:
fix: use plugin classloader in RepositoryScanner for async thread safety

RepositoryScanner was using Reflections with no explicit classloader,
causing it to fall back to the ForkJoinPool worker thread's TCCL (the
JEDependency library classloader) which has no visibility into the plugin
JAR. This meant 0 repositories were discovered and every repos.get() call
threw RepositoryException.

Fixed by mirroring the existing EntityScanner approach: use
RepositoryScanner.class.getClassLoader() + the plugin JAR URL from
ProtectionDomain.getCodeSource().getLocation() so Reflections always
scans the correct JAR regardless of which thread calls build().

Also bump version to 3.0.3.

commits.author: JExcellence | Justin
commits.message:
fix(cache): implement proper caching strategies per industry best practices

Audit and fix caching implementation against cache-aside, write-through,
thundering herd prevention, and stale-while-revalidate patterns.

Thundering herd prevention:
- findById() and findByKey() now use Caffeine's get(key, loader) which
  coalesces concurrent cache misses into a single DB query. Previously
  used getIfPresent() + manual put, meaning N concurrent misses for the
  same key caused N parallel database queries.

TTL jitter (mass expiry prevention):
- Cache expiration times now include configurable random jitter (default
  10% of TTL). A 30-minute TTL becomes 27-33 minutes. Prevents stampede
  when preload() writes thousands of entries at the same instant and they
  all expire together.

Stale-while-revalidate:
- New refreshAfterWrite option in CacheConfig. When set, expired entries
  serve stale data immediately while Caffeine triggers an async background
  reload. Users never block on cache revalidation. Leverages Caffeine's
  native refresh mechanism.

Bounded preload:
- Added preload(int limit) and preloadAsync(int limit) for large tables.
  Previous preload() loaded the entire table into memory with no safety
  bound.

Cache observability:
- Added logCacheStats() method that logs hit rate, hit/miss counts,
  eviction count, and cache size per layer at INFO level. Stats were
  recorded via recordStats() but never surfaced.

Cache contract documentation:
- Documented staleness window, invalidation strategy, cold start
  behavior, and consistency model in class javadoc.

Cross-population:
- findById() now cross-populates the key cache on hit, and findByKey()
  cross-populates the ID cache. Previously each layer was only populated
  through its own lookup path.

CacheConfig additions:
- refreshAfterWrite (Duration) — stale-while-revalidate trigger
- jitterPercent (int, 0-50) — TTL jitter percentage

commits.author: JExcellence | Justin
commits.message:
refactor!: JEHibernate 3.0 — complete overhaul with Java 17+ support

Comprehensive refactoring addressing critical bugs in entity lifecycle,
caching, query consistency, and session management. Adds Java 17/21/24
compatibility, session-scoped lazy loading, enhanced query builder,
and production-ready configuration.

BREAKING CHANGES:
- Minimum Java version lowered from 24 to 17 (broader compatibility)
- BaseEntity.setVersion() changed from public to protected
- QueryBuilder.orderBy()/orderByDesc() now accumulate (multi-sort)
  instead of replacing the previous sort
- DatabaseType.MSSQL_SERVER prefix changed from "mssql_server" to "mssql"
- AbstractCachedRepository constructor accepts CacheConfig record
  instead of raw Duration/int parameters (old constructor still works)

Critical bug fixes:
- BaseEntity equals/hashCode: added transient UUID identityToken so
  unpersisted entities are no longer all "equal" in HashSet/HashMap
- save(): uses Identifiable.isNew() instead of em.contains() which
  always returned false due to fresh EntityManager per call
- createAll/updateAll: removed em.clear() mid-batch that caused
  detached entity corruption in returned result lists
- OptimisticLockRetry: walks full cause chain to catch Hibernate-wrapped
  StaleObjectStateException, StaleStateException, LockAcquisitionException
- QueryBuilder.getPage(): count + data query now execute in single
  EntityManager for consistent pagination results
- RepositoryRegistry.get(): replaced synchronized block with
  ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent() for better concurrency
- AbstractCachedRepository: replaced reflection-based getId() with
  direct Identifiable interface cast (was calling getMethod on every
  cache operation)
- Cache invalidation: added missing overrides for updateAll(),
  deleteAll(), saveAll(), deleteEntity() to maintain consistency
- fromProperties(): now reads {prefix}.driver and {prefix}.dialect
  overrides from properties files (were silently ignored before)

Session management (lazy loading):
- New SessionContext class wrapping an open EntityManager
- withSession()/withSessionVoid(): transactional session scope where
  lazy-loaded associations work correctly
- withReadOnly(): read-only session scope without transaction overhead
- Available on both repositories and JEHibernate entry point

Query builder enhancements:
- Multi-field sorting: orderBy()/orderByDesc() accumulate sort orders
- OR conditions: or(), orWhere(), orLike() combined as
  AND(and_specs) AND OR(or_specs)
- Fetch joins: fetch()/fetchLeft() for N+1 query prevention
- Streaming: stream() with try-with-resources for large datasets
- Built-in slow query logging (warns above 500ms threshold)

New repository methods:
- saveAll(Collection): batch save detecting new vs existing entities
- deleteEntity(T): delete by entity reference
- refresh(T): re-read entity from database discarding in-memory changes
- existsBy(Specification): specification-based existence check
- Async variants: saveAllAsync(), deleteEntityAsync()

Caching improvements:
- CacheConfig record with builder: expiration, maxSize, expireAfterAccess
- Full cache consistency on all mutation paths
- Eliminated reflection-based ID extraction

Configuration and performance:
- Connection pooling: connectionPool(min, max) for Agroal
- Second-level cache: enableSecondLevelCache() for JCache
- Better Hibernate defaults: batch_size=25, order_inserts/updates=true,
  query_plan_cache=2048, connection_provider_disables_autocommit=true
- Bukkit-friendly loading: PropertyLoader.load(File, String...)
  and JEHibernate.fromProperties(File, String...)

Infrastructure:
- TransactionTemplate: added executeReadOnly(), public classifyException()
  used across all exception handling (eliminated duplication)
- QueryLogger: configurable slow query threshold with WARN logging
- RepositoryFactory: tries multiple constructor signatures for flexibility
- Fixed signing config to support both signingKey and signingInMemoryKey
  property naming conventions

Java 17/21/24 compatibility:
- Compile target set to Java 17 (records, sealed interfaces standard)
- Pattern matching switches replaced with if/else instanceof chains
- List.getFirst() replaced with get(0)
- Virtual threads detected at runtime via reflection — automatic on
  Java 21+, falls back to cached thread pool on Java 17-20
- Removed --enable-preview flag

Documentation:
- Complete README.md rewrite with all features documented
- Example hibernate.properties with all database types
- Example simplelogger.properties for SLF4J configuration
- Updated BukkitPluginExample with properties-based setup
- New SpringBootExample with full service layer patterns
- 20 new tests covering all refactored features (78 total, 0 failures)
